{{Top|leg}}
'''Auto-steady gyrogimbals''' were weapon components that assisted in keeping a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] steady while firing. [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.'s]] [[LD-1 target blaster rifle]] employed auto-steady gyrogimbals.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
